name: Cat Platformer
description: Classic 2D platformer starter. Cat hero with idle/walk/jump animations, gravity & jump physics, coin pickups, simple enemy patrol, lives counter, and a single hand-crafted level using a 32x32 tileset.
prompt_template: Build a Unity 2D side-scrolling platformer. The hero is a cat sprite with idle/walk/jump animations. Add gravity, jump on space, walk on A/D. Include a Tilemap floor with a few platforms, 3 coin pickups, and a simple enemy that walks left/right on a platform. UI shows coin count and 3 lives. Use Cinemachine for camera follow.
